name: Circlet
author: Erin Carter
description: Five beads of mercury ride a single invisible circular groove, summed and smooth-min iso-surfaced so closeness along the arc makes neighbours neck and wick into longer liquid arcs. Their spacing breathes on incommensurate offsets, so fusions wander around the ring; once per grand cycle all five fuse into one unbroken glowing annulus, then bead apart again. Dark mirror interiors, a doubled rim highlight on the outer edge, hue circulating by angle, and a colour-3 spark at every neck snap.

params.label: Ring radius
params.effect: Radius of the invisible groove the beads ride, in css pixels.

params.label: Flow speed
params.effect: How fast the beads circulate and how often the full annulus forms.

params.label: Bead size
params.effect: Radius of each mercury bead in css pixels; larger beads fuse into arcs more readily and hold the annulus longer.

params.label: Snap glow
params.effect: Brightness of the colour-3 spark at every neck snap; at zero fusions pass with rim light only.
